test: Claude sign-in shows pending progress and resumes polling after a connection error
expected: the Jevellan web app "login recovery" screen at desktop-light, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "Claude sign-in shows pending progress and resumes polling after a connection error"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The dialog title shows the raw recovery UUID ('Login recovery a248ef53-2882-4541-ab68-c62306a84e72'). It's long and reads like an internal ID, not a friendly label.

The status line says 'Code sent. Waiting for sign-in to finish…' while the error banner below says 'Can't reach Jevellan'. Showing both at once may confuse people about what state the sign-in is in, though that may be intended for this connection-error step.
The vertical spacing between the 'Open sign-in page' button, the status text and 'Start again' is tight compared with the rest of the dialog's padding.
